newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Bad weather forces Arafat to postpone Jordan visit.
newsitem.headline: Bad weather forces Arafat to postpone Jordan visit.

text.p: Palestinian President Yasser Arafat postponed on Monday a planned visit to Jordan due to bad weather, aides said.
They said Arafat was expected to fly to Amman on Monday for a one-day courtesy call to Jordan's King Hussein, who underwent minor knee surgery on Sunday.
The officials gave no new date for the visit but said it would take place as soon as the weather improved.
Jordanian officials have said Arafat was also due to hold talks with Crown Prince Hassan and Prime Minister Abdul-Karim al-Kabariti on Middle East peace moves.
